title: Does the added modality help?
prompt: Compare ultrasound alone with registered US + PA using the same task and ground truth.
gate: Measure localization, registration, failed acquisitions and additional time. Predefine what benefit would justify the extra system.

title: Can contact preserve the anatomy?
prompt: Evaluate the passive shoe, force sensing, air gaps and motion across compliant vessel phantoms.
gate: Record vessel deformation and coupling loss. Establish materials, cleaning and sterility requirements.

title: Where does optical contrast fail?
prompt: Vary attenuation, pigmentation, depth, hematoma-like absorbers and illumination geometry.
gate: Report performance by condition. Include UNKNOWN states and uncertainty instead of a universal correction claim.

title: Which objects can be localized?
prompt: Study metal, glass and other relevant materials across sizes, depths and orientations.
gate: Report sensitivity, specificity and localization error. No negative result may imply all fragments have been excluded.

title: Can a trained user interpret it?
prompt: Review gloved controls, attention demands, misleading overlays, motion and low-perfusion use cases with clinicians.
gate: Measure task completion and use errors. Human-factors review precedes claims about field benefit.

title: What evidence would permit human use?
prompt: Define intended use with clinical, regulatory and safety experts before appropriately approved human studies.
gate: Clinical safety, effectiveness, legal pathway and field suitability remain unverified. Reviewed below means discussed, not clinically validated.
